content.short: Accumulated Finance is an omnichain modular liquid staking protocol for yield maximization and LST-backed lending.
content.description: Accumulated Finance is an omnichain modular liquid staking protocol designed to maximize the yield, liquidity, and utility of staked assets across multiple blockchains. Users can stake PoS assets to mint Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) at a 1:1 ratio, which then serve as collateral in isolated lending markets. The platform introduces "Leverage Staking," allowing users to achieve up to 50x leverage through recursive staking strategies. Operating on its specialized AEVM app-chain, Accumulated Finance provides a high-performance environment optimized for cross-chain DeFi operations and yield generation.
